en.description: Made under license by JLA Home, this plush blanket runs 20 heat settings from 85 to 105°F with a timer you set anywhere from 1 to 10 hours, two controllers on queen and king, UL certification, OEKO-TEX fabric and a 5-year warranty. It has the finest heat control on this list and a clean record in the 2016 to 2026 CPSC electric blanket recalls I checked.

zh-tw.description: 由授權廠 JLA Home 生產，20 段溫控落在華氏 85 到 105 度，定時 1 到 10 小時自己選，雙人以上附兩個控制器，UL 認證、OEKO-TEX 布料、五年保固。溫控是全榜最細的，我查的 2016 到 2026 年 CPSC 電熱毯召回清單裡也找不到它，第一名給它我很放心。

en.description: Pure Enrichment's own store lists this micromink blanket at $99.99 in every size from twin to king, with 10 heat levels from 87 to 105°F, a 10-hour auto shut-off, a UL listing and a 5-year warranty. Queen and king get dual controllers and draw 200 W, which is the figure I used for the cost-per-night math on this page.

zh-tw.description: 官網從單人到加大雙人一律 99.99 美元，10 段溫控落在華氏 87 到 105 度，10 小時自動斷電，UL 認證加五年保固。雙人跟加大雙人附兩個控制器、耗電 200 瓦，這頁的電費試算我就是拿這個數字算的。尺寸越大越划算，買雙人的人最賺。

en.description: Serta's plush heated blanket comes from the same licensee as Beautyrest, JLA Home, and pairs 10 heat settings with the longest timer in my top three, selectable from 1 to 12 hours. It is ETL certified, uses dual controllers on queen and larger, and sells for $115 to $141 in queen at Home Depot and Amazon.

zh-tw.description: 跟 Beautyrest 出自同一家授權廠 JLA Home，10 段溫控，定時 1 到 12 小時可選，是我前三名裡定時最長的。ETL 認證，雙人以上附雙控制器。怕半夜冷醒、想整晚開著的人，選它就對了。

en.description: An under-blanket you lie on, sold through Beurer's Taiwan store with BSMI registration T36153 printed on the listing, Öko-Tex Standard 100 fabric, dual controllers at 60 W per side, a 6-hour auto shut-off, a detachable cord for machine washing and a 3-year warranty. zh-tw.description: 德國博依的雙人床墊型電毯，商檢字號 T36153 直接印在官方購物網上，Öko-Tex Standard 100 布料，雙人雙控每邊 60 瓦，6 小時自動斷電，電源線拆下來整條丟洗衣機，保固三年。老實說，在台灣要買一條放心睡整季的，我就買這條。

en.description: The Royal Ultra Fleece queen gives you 12 heat settings, a selectable auto shut-off up to 12 hours and a detachable controller so the blanket goes in the washer and dryer, for about $60 at Walmart. zh-tw.description: 雙人款 12 段溫控、自動斷電最長 12 小時可選，控制器拆掉後可以洗也可以烘，Walmart 大約 60 美元，是美國大牌裡最便宜的。要提醒一件事，Sunbeam 在 2023 年 3 月被 CPSC 公告召回 4.3 萬條雙人電熱毯（型號 32810027，由 Star Elite 經銷），買清倉品之前記得翻標籤看型號。

en.description: Degrees of Comfort sells this microplush blanket for $59.99 on its own store with 20 heat levels, a preheat setting, UL certification and a 5-year warranty across six sizes up to California king. It is the cheapest UL-certified bed-size option I found, and many size and color combinations were sold out when I checked in September.

zh-tw.description: 官網 59.99 美元，20 段溫控、有預熱模式、UL 認證、五年保固，尺寸從單人一路做到加州加大雙人。這是我找到最便宜、又有 UL 認證的床用尺寸，CP 值很漂亮，只是九月我去看的時候很多尺寸跟顏色已經賣完。

en.description: Northern's graphene-fabric under-blanket costs NT$2,980 for a 130 x 160 cm double, draws 120 W, offers five heat levels and a 1 to 8 hour timer, and prints its BSMI inspection number T33246 on the product page. The warranty is one year.

zh-tw.description: 北方的石墨烯床墊式電熱毯，雙人 130 x 160 公分，120 瓦，五段溫控，定時 1 到 8 小時，商檢字號 T33246 就寫在官網商品頁上。三千塊有找就能買到有字號、雙人尺寸的電熱毯，預算有限的人我會推這條，保固一年。

en.description: Sunlus's SP2701 is a light 80 x 140 cm single blanket with four heat levels, a fixed 8-hour auto shut-off and a body you can wash once the controller and cord are unplugged, at NT$1,680 on sale from a NT$2,380 list price. It carries a one-year warranty plus NT$20 million in product liability insurance.

zh-tw.description: 三樂事的輕薄單人電熱毯，80 x 140 公分，四段溫控，8 小時自動斷電，控制器跟電線拔掉後毯子本體可以水洗，官網特價 NT$1,680。保固一年，另外投保 2,000 萬產品責任險。一個人睡、宿舍或套房用剛剛好，下單前記得看包裝上的商品檢驗標識。

en.description: Bedsure's GentleSoft flannel throw is a 50 x 60 inch couch blanket at $68.99 with six heat levels, four timer options, a 3-hour auto shut-off and ETL certification. Bedsure's record includes a March 2023 CPSC recall of about 350,000 heating blankets and pads sold from August through November 2022, after 137 reports of fire, burning, melting and overheating.

zh-tw.description: Bedsure 的法蘭絨電熱蓋毯，50 x 60 英寸，六段溫控、四種定時、3 小時自動斷電，ETL 認證，官網 68.99 美元。3 小時的設計講白了就是沙發追劇用的。另外 Bedsure 在 2023 年 3 月有一次約 35 萬件的 CPSC 召回，涵蓋 2022 年 8 月到 11 月賣出的電熱毯與電熱墊，當時累計 137 起起火、燒焦、熔化或過熱通報。

en.commentary:
I ranked electric blankets by one question first: if this thing stays plugged in next to me for eight hours tonight, what evidence do I have that it will behave? That question reorders the whole category, because this year's safety problems came from the cheapest and easiest blankets to buy.

At the end of July 2026 the CPSC announced a recall of about 178,000 OCTROT heated sherpa throws and blankets sold on Amazon between August 2021 and December 2025 for $40 to $60. The cord can detach and ignite, and the agency counted 555 reports of melting, sparking or smoking, including 27 fires and 15 injuries. On July 16 the CPSC told owners of roughly 700 Melinora blankets to stop using them after heating wires melted through the fabric, and it issued that notice as a warning because the manufacturer, Leevana Inc., stopped responding to the agency. Both products were low-priced, sold through Amazon and carried names nobody would recognize in a store.

So my top three are brands with a named safety listing, a five-year warranty and a clean record in the CPSC electric blanket recalls I checked from 2016 through 2026. Beautyrest wins on control: 20 heat settings between 85 and 105°F, a timer you choose from 1 to 10 hours, two controllers on a queen, UL certification and OEKO-TEX fabric. Pure Enrichment is the easiest recommendation on price at $99.99 in every size on its own store. Serta comes third, and here is the detail most shoppers never see: Beautyrest and Serta heated blankets are both made by the same licensee, JLA Home, so the choice between them comes down to the controller and the price tag.

Two well-known brands carry recall history. Sunbeam recalled 43,000 queen blankets in March 2023, and Bedsure recalled about 350,000 heating blankets and pads the same month. Both recalls covered specific model numbers and sale windows. I still like Sunbeam's Royal Ultra at about $60, so I scored the record honestly and let price and controls carry it to fifth.

Running cost is the quiet argument for the whole category. A queen blanket drawing 200 W for eight hours uses 1.6 kWh, about 29 cents at the 18.02-cent average residential rate the EIA projects for 2026. A 1,500 W space heater over the same eight hours costs about $2.16. That gap is why I warm the bed and let the room stay cool.

Three models here come from the Taiwan market, and all three are under-blankets you lie on. Beurer's TP 88 XXL and Northern's NR-361G both print their BSMI inspection numbers on the product page, and that printed number is the check I weight most for Taiwan buyers. When Taiwan's Consumer Protection Committee and BSMI bought 10 electric blankets from online and retail channels in 2021, three failed, with results announced in March 2022.

highlights.title: Check the seller's recall record before you touch the fabric
highlights.body: The CPSC database is the most useful spec sheet in this category. OCTROT's 178,000-unit recall followed 555 incident reports, and Melinora's warning came after five reports and one burn injury from a manufacturer that went silent. Among the brands I ranked, Beautyrest, Pure Enrichment, Serta and Degrees of Comfort have a clean record in the 2016 to 2026 electric blanket recalls I reviewed. Sunbeam (43,000 queens, March 2023) and Bedsure (about 350,000 blankets and pads, March 2023) each have one, and I scored that column down for both. Search the brand name on cpsc.gov before you buy. It takes one minute.

highlights.title: Beautyrest earns first place with the finest control on the list
highlights.body: Twenty heat settings across an 85 to 105°F window is the widest usable adjustment I found, and the timer runs anywhere from 1 to 10 hours so you can match it to the time you actually fall asleep. A queen ships with two controllers, the blanket carries UL and OEKO-TEX certification, and the warranty runs five years. Queen pricing moves between about $104 and $152 depending on the retailer, which is the one column where Pure Enrichment's flat $99.99 comes out ahead.

highlights.title: Beautyrest and Serta share a maker, so choose on the controller
highlights.body: Both brands license their heated bedding to JLA Home, which manufactures the blankets and handles warranty claims for each. That makes the decision simple. Pick Beautyrest for 20 settings and a UL listing. Pick Serta for the longer 1 to 12 hour timer and an ETL listing at $115 to $141 for a queen. Both use dual controllers on queen and larger sizes, so couples get independent sides with either one.

highlights.title: A warm bed costs about 29 cents a night
highlights.body: Pure Enrichment publishes 200 W for its queen and king blankets. Eight hours at full power is 1.6 kWh, and at the EIA's projected 2026 average residential rate of 18.02 cents that works out to about 29 cents. Blanket thermostats cycle, so real nights land lower. A 1,500 W space heater over the same eight hours uses 12 kWh and costs about $2.16. For keeping one bed warm, the blanket does the job on roughly one seventh of the electricity.

highlights.title: A 3-hour shut-off makes it a couch blanket
highlights.body: Auto shut-off length tells you what a product was designed for. Bedsure's GentleSoft throw stops after 3 hours, which suits an evening on the sofa. Sunbeam's Royal Ultra queen and Serta run up to 12 hours, Beautyrest up to 10, and Pure Enrichment a fixed 10. For overnight bedding I want at least 8 hours, and four of my top five meet that. Beurer's TP 88 XXL stops at 6 hours, and I accept that trade for its 60 W per side and its printed BSMI number.

zh-tw.commentary:
先講結論，電熱毯這個品類我第一個看安全紀錄，布料軟硬排在很後面。理由很簡單，這東西整晚插著電蓋在你身上，今年美國出事的偏偏就是最便宜、最好買的那一群。

2026 年 7 月底，美國消費品安全委員會 CPSC 公告 OCTROT 在 Amazon 賣的雪花絨電熱毯召回，數量大約 17.8 萬件，2021 年 8 月到 2025 年 12 月之間賣出，售價 40 到 60 美元。問題出在電源線會脫落起火，累計 555 起熔化、冒火花或冒煙的通報，其中 27 起火災、15 人受傷。7 月 16 日 CPSC 又對大約 700 件 Melinora 電熱毯發出停用警告，發熱線會過熱熔穿布料，製造商 Leevana 對 CPSC 完全沒有回應，只好由官方直接發警告。兩件事的共通點講白了就是三個：便宜、Amazon 第三方賣家、叫不出名字的品牌。

所以我前三名給了有安全認證、有五年保固，而且在我查的 2016 到 2026 年 CPSC 電熱毯召回清單裡找不到的品牌。Beautyrest 第一，20 段溫控落在華氏 85 到 105 度，定時 1 到 10 小時自己選，雙人尺寸附兩個控制器，UL 認證加 OEKO-TEX 布料。Pure Enrichment 第二，官網全尺寸一律 99.99 美元，換算大約 NT$3,150。Serta 第三，這裡要跟大家說一件很少人知道的事，Beautyrest 跟 Serta 的電熱毯其實是同一家授權廠 JLA Home 做的，兩個要挑哪個，看控制器跟價格就好。

有召回紀錄的知名品牌也有兩家。Sunbeam 在 2023 年 3 月召回 4.3 萬條雙人電熱毯，Bedsure 同一個月召回約 35 萬件電熱毯與電熱墊。兩次都只涉及特定型號與銷售期間，Sunbeam Royal Ultra 大約 60 美元的價格我還是很喜歡，所以這一欄照實扣分，其他交給價格跟功能去拚，最後落在第五。

說到電費，這是整個品類最有說服力的地方。美國雙人電熱毯 200 瓦開 8 小時是 1.6 度電，1,500 瓦電暖器開同樣時間是 12 度，差了七倍多。

最後是台灣讀者最該看的部分。這份榜單有三款是台灣通路買得到的，德國博依 TP 88 XXL、北方 NR-361G 跟三樂事 SP2701，前兩款都把商檢字號直接印在商品頁上。台灣的電熱毯大多是鋪在床墊上、人躺在上面的床墊型，美國主流則是蓋在身上的蓋毯型，用起來差很多。換算台灣電價，北方 120 瓦開 8 小時不到 1 度電，照非夏月每度 1.78 元算，一晚大約 NT$1.7，比超商一顆茶葉蛋還便宜。

highlights.title: 買電熱毯先查召回紀錄，這一步只要一分鐘
highlights.body: CPSC 的召回資料庫是這個品類最好用的規格表。OCTROT 17.8 萬件召回之前累積了 555 起通報，Melinora 則是 5 起通報、1 人燙傷，製造商還直接已讀不回。我排進榜單的品牌裡，Beautyrest、Pure Enrichment、Serta 跟 Degrees of Comfort 在 2016 到 2026 年的電熱毯召回清單裡都找不到，Sunbeam（2023 年 3 月，4.3 萬條雙人毯）跟 Bedsure（2023 年 3 月，約 35 萬件）各有一次，這一欄我兩家都扣分。買美國品牌之前上 cpsc.gov 搜一下品牌名，一分鐘就查完。

highlights.title: 在台灣買，商檢字號印在頁面上的直接加分
highlights.body: 電熱毯在台灣屬於應施檢驗商品，沒通過檢驗就不能上架。可是市面上還是有漏網之魚，行政院消保處跟標準檢驗局 2021 年從網購平台等通路買了 10 件電熱毯送驗，2022 年 3 月公布結果，3 件不合格，1 件標示不符、1 件品質不合格而且涉及逃避檢驗、1 件品質不合格。德國博依 TP 88 XXL 的字號 T36153、北方 NR-361G 的 T33246 都直接寫在商品頁，這種我最放心。三樂事 SP2701 的商品頁我沒看到字號，下單前記得看包裝上的商品檢驗標識。至於代購進來的美國電熱毯，身上沒有台灣的商品檢驗標識，保固也得找美國原廠處理，這點要先想清楚。

highlights.title: Beautyrest 跟 Serta 同一家廠做的，挑控制器就好
highlights.body: 兩個牌子的電熱寢具都授權給 JLA Home 生產，保固申請也是 JLA Home 在處理。所以決策很簡單，想要 20 段溫控跟 UL 認證就選 Beautyrest，想要 1 到 12 小時的長定時跟 ETL 認證就選 Serta，雙人款 115 到 141 美元，換算大約 NT$3,600 到 4,400。兩家雙人以上都是雙控制器，怕熱的跟怕冷的睡同一張床也能各自調。

highlights.title: 電熱毯一晚的電費，比一顆茶葉蛋還便宜
highlights.body: 德國博依 TP 88 XXL 每邊 60 瓦，兩邊全開 120 瓦，睡滿 6 小時自動斷電是 0.72 度。北方 NR-361G 120 瓦開 8 小時是 0.96 度，照台電非夏月每度 1.78 元算，一晚大約 NT$1.7，而且溫控器會自己跳，實際更少。對照一台 1,200 瓦的電暖器開 8 小時是 9.6 度，一個月天天開就是 288 度，光這台就會把你家電費推進更高的級距。寒流來的晚上想睡得暖，暖被窩比暖整個房間划算太多。

highlights.title: 台灣濕冷的冬天，我選床墊型
highlights.body: 台灣買得到的電熱毯大多是床墊型，鋪在床墊上、人躺在上面，上面再蓋自己的棉被，熱從下面上來、被子把熱關住，寒流天的濕冷感消得很快。德國博依 TP 88 XXL 就是這種設計，雙人雙控、每邊 60 瓦、6 小時自動斷電，睡前開、半夜自己關，電源線拆掉整條可以機洗，保固三年，官方購物網 NT$4,780，大概是一台入門除濕機的價錢。預算想壓在三千以內，北方 NR-361G 的 NT$2,980 一樣有字號、一樣是雙人尺寸，保固一年。

en.commentary:
My ranking holds this week, and the Beautyrest Plush Heated Blanket keeps first place at 9.1. It is a machine-washable microlight plush blanket with a digital controller, multiple heat settings and an automatic shut-off, and it wins because its controller gives the finest heat steps on this list from a brand with a clean recent recall record.

No new heated blanket recall has been posted in the past week. The July OCTROT recall is still circulating, and WRAL's coverage keeps the numbers in front of shoppers: more than 170,000 sherpa throws sold on Amazon, 555 reports of melting, sparking or smoking, 27 fires and 15 injuries. If you bought a cheap sherpa heated throw online in the last few years, check the brand name against the CPSC notice before the first cold night.

Mid-September is the right moment for what I call the first-night inspection. Before you plug in a blanket that spent the summer folded in a closet, lay it flat and run your hand along the whole surface for hard spots or kinks in the wiring. Check the cord where it meets the connector for cracks or discoloration. Then run it on low for fifteen minutes while you stay in the room. A blanket that develops a hot spot gets retired, with no second chances.

Pure Enrichment PureRelief Deluxe holds second at 8.9 for its fast warm-up, and the Beurer TP 88 XXL stays fourth at 8.5 as the under-blanket I recommend for Taiwan buyers. It carries local support, a timer and a double-bed size that heats the mattress before you get in.

Taiwan's standards bureau has tested electric blankets on the local market, and I still treat that report as required reading for anyone shopping from marketplaces this winter.

highlights.title: Run a first-night inspection before plugging in
highlights.body: Flatten the blanket, feel for kinks or hard spots, check the cord for cracks, then test on low for fifteen minutes while you stay in the room.

highlights.title: The OCTROT recall still matters
highlights.body: More than 170,000 Amazon sherpa throws are covered after 555 reports of melting, sparking or smoking. Check the brand name before first use.

highlights.title: Beautyrest keeps first at 9.1
highlights.body: Fine heat steps, auto shut-off and a washable plush shell from a brand with a clean recent recall record.

highlights.title: Beurer TP 88 XXL for Taiwan beds
highlights.body: A timer, local support and a double-bed under-blanket format make it my pick for pre-warming a mattress in damp winters.

zh-tw.commentary:
這週排名沒動，Beautyrest Plush Heated Blanket 繼續以 9.1 分拿第一。它是可以丟洗衣機的輕柔絨毛電熱毯，數位控制器、多段溫度，還有自動斷電。我讓它坐第一，理由是控制器的溫度段數分得最細，而且品牌近年的召回紀錄很乾淨。

The Beautyrest Plush Heated Blanket keeps first at 9.1 and the ranking holds. This week I want to make the economic case for the category, because mid September is when heated bedding goes to full price with the best selection of the year, and plenty of people talk themselves out of buying one.

Here is the arithmetic. A queen size heated blanket draws roughly 100 watts on its highest setting. A 1500 watt space heater draws fifteen times that. Over an eight hour night, the blanket costs you about 0.8 kilowatt hours and the heater costs about 12. Warming the person under the covers is the cheapest heat in the house, and it lets you drop the whole home thermostat a few degrees overnight while sleeping warmer than you did before.

That is why the controller is the spec I score hardest. The Beautyrest wins on heat steps. Its digital controller divides the range finely enough that you can find the setting that holds you at comfortable through the night, and its auto shutoff ends the session for you. Blankets with three coarse settings force a choice between chilly and sweating.

On timing, heating gear sits on the expensive side of the September line while cooling gear clears out. Prime Big Deal Days on 6 and 7 October is the first real discount window of the season. Three weeks is an easy wait in mild weather.

Two care rules before the first cold night. Never sleep on a heated blanket that has been folded along the same creases in storage, because repeated creasing is where wiring fails. Lay it flat on the bed, run it on low for twenty minutes, and feel the whole surface for cold patches or hot spots.

And the Sunbeam recall in the dataset covered a 2023 Star Elite queen blanket, separate from the Royal Ultra Fleece I rank fifth.

The Home Picker also found that OCTROT's blankets were on sale for 52 months before the recall. That is why I weight established brands with published controller certifications heavily. en.commentary:
The Beautyrest Plush Heated Blanket keeps first at 9.1 and the ranking holds. Last week was the recall check. This week the utilities have published their heating season safety lists, and I want to turn those rules into buying criteria, because each rule points to a feature worth paying for.

Hendricks Power and Indiana Connection both carry the same core guidance for electric blankets: never fold one while it is on, keep other blankets and pets off the top while it runs, replace any blanket with dark, charred or frayed spots, and avoid sleeping under a heated top blanket for the whole night.

Rule one, no folding, is about hot spots. A fold doubles the wiring in one place and traps the heat. The fix is a blanket that lies flat and stays flat. The Beautyrest Plush earns first place because its fabric drapes evenly over a mattress and the heat spreads across the whole surface. Store it rolled loosely, which keeps the wires from creasing in the same place every spring.

Rule two, nothing on top, is where the controller earns its keep. The Pure Enrichment PureRelief Deluxe at 8.9 has a controller with multiple heat levels and an auto shutoff, so you can preheat the bed on high and let the timer end the session.

Rule three, overnight use, points to the two under-blankets on my list. The Beurer TP 88 XXL at 8.5 and the Northern NR-361G at 7.9 are designed to sit under the sheet, and they are the format I recommend for anyone who likes gentle heat through the night. The guidance against using a blanket as a mattress pad applies to top blankets. An under-blanket is engineered for that position.

The inspection takes two minutes. Unfold the blanket in good light, check both sides for discolored patches, and run your hand along the cord.

Prime Big Deal Days runs 6 to 7 October, and heated bedding usually sees its first real discounts then.

references.title: 10 Best Electric Blankets for Beds (September 2026) Expert Reviews
Good Housekeeping 2026 Bedding Awards: Picks seen on 'GMA'

en.commentary:
Sleep awards season this month put electric blankets under more scrutiny than they usually get, Good Housekeeping's Institute tested over 300 bedding products with more than 800 at home testers this year, fiber scientists spending six months on sheets, pillows, blankets, and comforters together, not treating heated blankets as an afterthought category. That level of testing rigor is exactly what this ranking has been pushing for since the CPSC recall wave earlier this cycle, JKMAX and OCTROT both pulled products after hundreds of combined burn and fire reports, and independent, multi-brand testing is the only real check against that kind of failure happening again.

Beautyrest's Plush Heated Blanket keeps the top spot because it still posts the strongest combined safety numbers in this category, a 9.5 recall record and 9.6 heat control score together, exactly the pairing that matters when a product sits on your bed running current all night. Pure Enrichment's PureRelief Deluxe holds a close rank two on the back of an 8.6 value score, delivering nearly identical safety numbers for meaningfully less money.

With this much independent testing volume converging on bedding this month, I expect certification verification and recall record to keep mattering more here than heat levels or fabric feel, safety is the one score on this list that a bad month can undo instantly.

Beautyrest 的 Plush Heated Blanket 能繼續守住第一名，是因為它在這個類別裡的安全性組合分數還是最強，9.5的召回紀錄分數搭配9.6的溫控分數，這正是一款整晚通電放在床上的產品最該重視的組合。Pure Enrichment 的 PureRelief Deluxe 緊咬在第二名，靠的是8.6的價格分數，用親民很多的價格做出幾乎一樣的安全性數字。

這個月獨立實測的量體這麼大規模集中在寢具類別上，我預期認證核實跟召回紀錄在這份榜單裡的重要性，接下來還是會超過溫控段數或布料觸感，安全分數是這份榜單上唯一一個壞一個月就會整個歸零的評分項目。

references.title: CPSC Announces Recall of Heating Blankets and Pads Sold on Amazon

en.commentary: Beautyrest's Plush Heated Blanket keeps the top spot on the same case that put it there, a 9.5 recall record score and a 9.6 heat control score, and safety is exactly the right thing to weight heavily in this category, an electric blanket is a product you run for hours while unconscious. That makes this week's recall news worth a direct mention, the CPSC announced a recall of JKMAX heating blankets and pads sold exclusively on Amazon, covering units sold from September 2022 through July 2026, after the internal wire heating elements were found capable of overheating and posing fire and burn hazards. JKMAX isn't a brand on this list, and I want to be clear that none of the nine competitors ranked here are implicated, but it's a useful real-world case for why the certVerify and recallRecord factors in this ranking carry genuine, earned weight in this score. Pure Enrichment's PureRelief Deluxe holds second at a matching 9.5 certification score and a 9.5 recall record, genuinely earning its spot as the safety-first alternative if you want a different brand than the category leader. For Taiwan-based readers, the Beurer TP 88 XXL stands out at rank four with a 9.8 Taiwan availability score, by far the easiest of this list to actually buy and get warranty service on locally, even though its heat control score trails the American market leaders. My advice is unchanged, buy on certification and recall record first in this category, then optimize for features.

Amazon Prime Big Deal Days 2026: October 6-7

en.commentary:
Beautyrest Plush Heated Blanket stays first, and with cooler nights arriving I want to give a shopping routine for the season. The first thing I check is the controller, since that is where the safety features live. I look for an auto shut-off, clear heat settings and a cord that feels well made, and I confirm the blanket carries a recognized safety listing. A CPSC heating blanket recall covered by Yahoo News is the reminder I keep on file, so I also search a model name plus the word recall before buying.

Pure Enrichment PureRelief Deluxe holds second with a plush feel and simple controls. Serta Plush Heated Blanket takes third, a good match for anyone who likes that familiar soft fleece texture. The Beurer TP 88 XXL Double Under-Blanket in fourth is a favorite of mine for couples, because an under-blanket warms the bed without adding weight on top. Sunbeam Royal Ultra Fleece adds a well-known name to the shortlist.

Practical use matters. Lay the blanket flat so the wiring is never bunched, and unplug it when you leave the room. Preheat the bed and turn it down before sleeping. Amazon has confirmed Prime Big Deal Days on October 6 and 7, 2026, a natural point for a fall blanket purchase.

No score changes this week.

zh-tw.commentary:
Beautyrest Plush Heated Blanket 繼續第一，夜晚開始變涼，我來分享這個季節的選購流程。我第一個檢查的是控制器，因為安全功能都在那裡。我會找有自動斷電、加熱檔位標示清楚、電線做工紮實的產品，也會確認有通過認可的安全認證。Yahoo News 報導過的 CPSC 電熱毯召回事件，是我一直放在心上的提醒，所以買之前我會搜尋型號加上「召回」兩個字。

Pure Enrichment PureRelief Deluxe 排第二，質感柔軟、操作簡單。Serta Plush Heated Blanket 排第三，很適合喜歡那種熟悉絨毛觸感的人。排第四的 Beurer TP 88 XXL 雙人電熱墊，是我推薦給情侶的款式，因為電熱墊只會讓床暖起來，上面不用多壓一層重量。Sunbeam Royal Ultra Fleece 則是知名品牌的選擇。

使用習慣也很重要。電熱毯要攤平使用，讓電線平整，離開房間時記得拔掉插頭。睡前先預熱，上床前調低檔位。台灣的冬天雖然不長，濕冷的寒流夜晚電熱毯特別有感，租屋處沒有暖氣的人更需要。雙 11 和年底特賣是入手的好時機，Amazon 也確認了 Prime Big Deal Days 在 10 月 6 日到 7 日。本週分數沒有變動。
